_comment: Public example only. What one machine supplies to the runtime adapter. Copy it outside this repository, replace every path, and keep the copy beside the private roots it names — never in the checkout. src/cli/generate-config.ts reads this and writes the runtime's own configuration, and src/cli/install-gateway-agent.ts reads it and writes the wrapper, the LaunchAgent and the rotation entry; it refuses any root inside the checkout, and refuses a secrets store the machine has left readable.
